```artifact
Feature: Offline Consultation Payment and User Interface Requirements

  Scenario: Offline Consultation payments are vide
    Given the user is on the Offline Consultation payment page
    When the user attempts to make a payment
    Then the payment should be processed successfully

  Scenario: Credit/Debit/Net Banking enabled through a Payment Gateway
    Given the user is on the Offline Consultation payment page
    When the user selects Credit/Debit/Net Banking option
    Then the Payment Gateway should be displayed

  Scenario: Error messages appear at the bottom and are self descriptive
    Given the user is on the Offline Consultation payment page
    When the user enters invalid payment details
    Then an error message should appear at the bottom of the page
    And the error message should be self descriptive

  Scenario Outline: The maximum size of error messages will be 80 Characters
    Given the user is on the Offline Consultation payment page
    When the user enters <input>
    Then the error message should not exceed 80 characters
    Examples:
      | input                  |
      | very long invalid input|
      | short input            |

  Scenario: Buttons will be used to make the navigation simpler
    Given the user is on the Offline Consultation payment page
    When the user clicks on the "Next" button
    Then the user should be navigated to the next screen

  Scenario: Patient Registration and Consultation Requests screens will have bigger font size to aid Elderly people
    Given the user is on the Patient Registration screen
    Then the font size should be bigger than the default font size

  Scenario: Consultation Requests screen will have bigger font size to aid Elderly people
    Given the user is on the Consultation Requests screen
    Then the font size should be bigger than the default font size

  Scenario: Exception error message will be displayed “Symptom does not exist”
    Given the user is on the Consultation Requests screen
    When the user enters a non-existent symptom
    Then the error message “Symptom does not exist” should be displayed
```
